baseline.method: Independent FFT-copy and rejected-residual corrected original CRISP two-cycle run

nrmse_definition: sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)), separately for each physical parameter map
reference_role: validated standard-method result; not physical truth
observation_definition: RMS residual separately for I,Q,U,V divided by fitting scales [.003,.0003,.0003,.003/3.5]; S1 mu=.93; independent SciPy complex Voigt and K-matrix solve
observation_boundary_provenance: 1.1 times independently captured full original-method values, fixed before judging cleaned output
azimuth_definition: delta=0.5*atan2(sin(2*(estimate-reference)),cos(2*(estimate-reference))); periodic_rms=sqrt(mean(delta^2))/pi; mean_cos2delta=mean(cos(2*delta)), higher better; this is not NCC
